doc.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Playing the tape for Miles Davis and Mingus
summary: She phoned Miles with a tape of the session and he called Mingus to the extension; their reaction confirmed her belief.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Playing with Miles Davis: joining, sessions and the band

blocks.x: Was there a decision after this record was over, like this is a trio right here?

Umm, again I left for Europe when it came out. There’s a nice story about when I came home after the session with a tape, and I called Miles and I said, “what do you think of this?” And four bars and he said, “wait a minute, wait a minute” he said, “Mingus, pick up the phone.” And he picked up the extension. And that was it. I mean they just — you know I wanted confirmation and also to let them hear what was going on. And I knew I was right. I knew I was right. And when they went crazy, that was it.
That’s a good story. Are you holding the phone to the speaker?
Yeah. A little tape recorder. A portable tape recorder. It wasn’t even a —
With the reels, right? This was a reel to reel tape?
No, this was a regular, little, as my mind recalls it, it was a regular little tape that they had done in the studio.
